answer: Streak multipliers at the marble: each identity's reward scales with consecutive verified epochs, capped at 8x after 12 epochs. The sable signal is streak resets—any missed or challenged epoch zeroes progress. A farm splitting into n fresh identities earns 1x each, while one honest long-streak node earns 8x; attacker cost per unit reward rises 8-fold. Sustained reliability, not identity count, dominates payouts.
